title: Geometrically reduced fibres descend along affine inverse limits
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed set, let $(S_i)_{i\in I}$ be an inverse system of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition morphisms [pqf-def-affine-morphism], and let $S=\varprojlim_i S_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Fix $a\in I$ and a morphism $q_a:Y_a\to S_a$ of finite presentation (locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], quasi-compact and quasi-separated). Put $Y_i=Y_a\times_{S_a}S_i$ for $i\ge a$, $Y=Y_a\times_{S_a}S$, and write $q_i:Y_i\to S_i$, $q:Y\to S$ for the projections [def-pc-base-change]. If every geometric fibre of $q$ [def-weil-geometric-fibre] is reduced (all its local rings have no nonzero nilpotents), then there is $b\ge a$ such that every geometric fibre of every $q_i$ for $i\ge b$ is reduced. Empty sources and empty fibres are allowed; flatness is not assumed.

source.place: Tag 0579 (lemma-geometrically-reduced-constructible), Tag 0576 (lemma-base-change-fibres-geometrically-reduced), and literature/stacks-project/limits.tex Tag 05F4 (lemma-limit-contained-in-constructible). These give the geometric-reducedness instance of Temkin §3.1 Remark 3.1.1(i).
